elements.element: Permitted renewal structure: renewal only by mutual written agreement, or automatic renewal subject to the preferred automatic-renewal safeguards.
elements.evidence: The clause uses automatic renewal and includes the required term length, Customer opt-out right, Vendor reminder, and price cap.

elements.element: If automatic renewal is used, each renewal term must be 12 months.
elements.evidence: The Agreement automatically renews for “an additional one year period” on each anniversary.

elements.element: If automatic renewal is used, Customer must be able to opt out on 30 days’ notice.
elements.evidence: Either Party, including the Company as Customer, may terminate on 30 days’ written notice.

elements.element: If automatic renewal is used, Vendor must remind Customer at least 60 days before each renewal.
elements.evidence: “HDI shall notify the Company at least 60 days before each renewal.”

elements.element: If automatic renewal is used, renewal-term price increases must be capped at the lesser of CPI and 3%.
elements.evidence: Any renewal-term fee increase “shall not exceed the lesser of CPI and 3%.”
The Agreement automatically renews for an additional one-year period on each anniversary.

elements.element: The non-renewal notice window must be no more than 60 days.
elements.evidence: The operative notice period is 30 days.

elements.element: Renewal-term price increases must not exceed 5%.
elements.evidence: The lesser-of-CPI-and-3% cap necessarily limits any permitted increase to no more than 3%, which is within the 5% fallback cap.

result.reason: The redline fully satisfies the preferred automatic-renewal alternative and therefore also satisfies fallback. It is not strictly minimal because changing the bilateral notice period from 90 to 30 days also gives HDI/Vendor a shorter termination or non-renewal right, whereas the preferred position requires only a 30-day Customer opt-out. The clause otherwise preserves the one-year renewal structure and introduces no contradiction, though the notice language could more clearly tie non-renewal to the anniversary date rather than appearing to permit termination on any specified date.
